review_id: review sequence number; R for the initial batch, Q for the machine core candidate queue
human_transcription_latex: formula LaTeX checked symbol by symbol against the page
human_m_labels: label list verified against the M01–M12 rules
human_m_node_witness: optional: human-identified M-label node witness; present only on some records
machine_record_fully_matches_gold: machine OCR, tree, labels and core status all agree with the human review
source_pdf_sha256: SHA-256 of the source PDF; the source PDF is not distributed
gold_accepted: whether the record is included in the Gold submission set
frozen_version_review_outcome: review outcome of the frozen version (accepted)
review_cohort: review batch through which the record entered Gold
formula_id: formula unique key; matches machine_formula_records.jsonl and machine_formula_trees.jsonl
source_id: book identifier; matches book_id in the source catalogue
source_file: source PDF filename; the source PDF is not distributed
locator: locator string of the form filename#page=...#candidate=...#bbox=...
candidate_number: candidate formula sequence number within the page
source_review_workbook: review workbook from which the record's review entry was taken; the workbook is not distributed
prior_source_run_id: identifier of the earlier run that supplied the record's review material
human_formula_candidate: reviewer judged the region to be a formula candidate rather than body text; true for all records in this package
human_region_complete: reviewer judged the detected region complete, with no clipped symbols; true for all records in this package
human_ocr_faithful_to_page: reviewer judged the archived machine OCR text faithful to the page; true for all records in this package
human_tree_faithful_to_page: reviewer judged the formula tree faithful to the page structure; true for all records in this package
human_structure_note: reviewer's free-text note recording the page region and the structure check for this record
machine_ocr_latex: machine OCR LaTeX from the frozen run
machine_tree_preorder: machine formula tree in preorder from the frozen run
machine_analysis_target_preorder: analysis target (main sub-tree) selected by the engine on the machine tree
machine_m_labels: M01-M12 labels computed by the frozen engine from the machine tree
machine_core_eligibility: whether the frozen engine marked the record as core-eligible; true for all records in this package
machine_final_status: final processing status of the frozen machine record; valid_for_core_stats for all records in this package
frozen_version_review_date: date on which the frozen-version review outcome was recorded
